description: Trace capture behaviour shared by pkg-r and pkg-py. The source is tests/shared/traces.json; the copy under pkg-r/tests/testthat/fixtures/shared/ is generated by scripts/sync-shared.sh. Edit the source and re-run that script.

content_capture.description: What content_capture_enabled() makes of the capture variable once trajectory logging has found tracing active. An unset or empty variable is turned on, since without it chat spans omit the messages. Any other value is a deliberate choice and is left as it was: "true" and "1" in any case mean on, everything else means off. `value` null means the variable is unset.

cases.name: an unset variable is turned on
an empty variable is treated as unset
any other value is an opt-out

setup_spans.description: The spans each package records while it sets up, whether or not trajectory logging is on. Span and attribute names are visible to anyone who reads a trace store. Each scenario names a setup both suites know how to run; a span recorded by it must have exactly the listed attributes, and a span named in `absent` must not be recorded. Sources have two tables, `orders` and `customers`. The context layer has two documents and no on-disk cache; `context prewarm cache hit` records the second of two prewarms. In `agent create`, the agent has one source, the context layer, and no semantic layer or dictionary. In `agent create with measures`, it has no context layer, one measure, and one source whose dictionary declares two definitions on `orders`. Semantic members and calculations come only from warehouse semantic views, so no scenario here has any.

conversation_turn.description: The span each package opens around one turn when trajectory logging is live. The turn's chat spans descend from it. It records the authenticated session user when there is one, set when the span starts. `session_user` is what the session reports; `module` true means the turn runs in a Shiny module's scope of that session, which reports the same user. `recorded` null means the attribute is absent.

user_cases.name: a user that is not a string

provenance.description: The span each package records once per completed answer when trajectory logging is live, as a child of the turn span, with both attributes set when the span starts. The turn span records neither attribute. The tag attribute is absent when the answer has no provenance tag. The candidates attribute is a JSON string: each package serializes `decisions` and the parsed result must equal `expected`.

candidates_cases.name: an accepted citation names its source

decisions.quote: Orders are one row per placed order.
decisions.label: orders notes

expected.quote: Orders are one row per placed order.
expected.label: orders notes

candidates_cases.name: a rejected citation has no source
a malformed body has no quote

file_naming.description: The file names `trajectory_read()` reads in a trace directory when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_FILE` is unset, so a writer must use a name marked `read`. `trace-latest.jsonl` is skipped because it is a hard link to the newest numbered file, which is already read.
